purpose: Harden the existing UKG Pro WFM and UKG Pro HCM specification coverage by treating HMAC webhooks and successful provider replay as signals only, requiring a complete read-only fallback snapshot before workforce reconciliation evidence can be admitted.

overrides.reason: UKG documents near-real-time WFM fat events, regional webhook services, HMAC validation, event-loss caveats, 14-day retention, failed-message replay, cursor-paginated replay audit and explicit secondary-polling guidance for zero-tolerance integrations.

HTTPS callback subscription protected by a revision-bound HMAC secret of at least 24 characters

successful replay is reconciled to a complete exact-window fallback snapshot before admission

page count, audit-page, message and snapshot-record caps are connection policy and fingerprint bound
429, transient 5xx and provider-outage recovery uses bounded backoff without widening tenant, subscription, region or time scope

test the callback and HMAC revision without creating business records

patch.productHandoff: Show one decision-ready event health card: latest authoritative snapshot time, failed/replayed/reconciled message counts, affected shift or time domain, freshness and exact failure layer. Do not expose raw callback tables or imply attendance or payroll approval.
patch.autonomyHandoff: Detect inactive subscriptions, missing event windows, HMAC rotation, token expiry, tenant/region drift, failed replays, cursor loops, provider outages and snapshot mismatch; auto-recover only by bounded token refresh, failed-only replay, backoff and read-only fallback polling, otherwise prepare the exact safest corrective action.
